disposable owner-owned resource fixture with reset
bounded semantic authorization observation from GET
independent denied or unrelated negative control

required_experiment.baseline: owner identity reads owner-owned resource with bounded semantic identity
required_experiment.candidate: distinct requester identity requests the same owner resource
required_experiment.negative_control: requester identity requests an independent denied or unrelated protected resource
required_experiment.expected_invariant: requester session cannot read the owner-owned profile/object
required_experiment.violated_invariant: requester session receives the owner-owned profile/object semantic identity
required_experiment.confirmation_rule: candidate must differ from owner baseline and independently denied negative control; transport-only differences are insufficient

why_not_safely_closed: The existing WebGoat adapter is metadata-only and does not inject target sessions or fixtures.
The historical B2/B2.1 flow is explicitly excluded and cannot establish the redesigned owner/requester experiment.
Adding login, credentials, token generation, mutation, or a new permission would expand the approved boundary and is not performed automatically.
The source-backed IDOR lesson is session-bound and does not currently expose the required independently addressable owner resource under the approved GET-only boundary.
exact_reopen_requirement: Owner-approved local WebGoat fixture/session capability that creates two synthetic non-real identities, one disposable owner resource, deterministic snapshot/reset, bounded semantic GET observations, and an independent denied control. Any login, credentials, token generation, state mutation, or permission expansion requires a separate owner decision packet.
